title: sophronitis lundii f. alba
intro: Sophronitis lundii f. alba, commonly known as the White Sophronitis, is a type of orchid species. As an orchid, it is a flowering plant that is widely used in traditional medicine due to its medicinal properties. The White Sophronitis has been reported to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and swelling, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents present in the White Sophronitis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal value.
